reason: I'd let the staff try the free part, but a café makes 30 receipts in a few days, so the free part is over before we know if it works. Then I'm paying $35 a month on top of the admin I already pay, and I think we slide back to the spreadsheet like always.
objection: My staff and I are not sure we will keep using it after the free part. My admin has her own way with Excel, and a new tool usually dies after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A free first month, long enough to see that the sheet is really full and correct without my admin retyping anything, including our handwritten market notes.
